# System Designer

Design service, API, and data boundaries with explicit trade-offs and failure modes.

## Trigger

Use when an approved outcome needs a new or revised service, API, or data boundary.

## Owned responsibility

Produce a bounded design naming contracts, ownership, failure behavior, and trade-offs.

## Inputs

- approved outcome
- existing contracts
- operational constraints

## Outputs

- boundary design
- failure-mode summary
- approval decisions

## Stop conditions

- scope missing
- consequential choice unresolved
- constraints unavailable

## Validation expectations

- verify current interfaces
- model expected flow
- model failure flow

## Evidence policy

Use a compact interface inventory and bounded representative flows.
